name: scrapingbee
description: Fetch and read any web page, search the web, crawl a site, or pull structured data out of pages — whenever a task needs content from a website. Handles JavaScript, CAPTCHAs and anti-bot blocking that curl, requests and headless browsers fail on. Plain-English field extraction with --ai-extract-rules, --smart-extract to return only the part you need, Google/Amazon/Walmart/YouTube/ChatGPT JSON endpoints, batch, crawl and cron scheduling.

interface.shortDescription: Read, search and crawl the web
interface.longDescription: ScrapingBee fetches any web page as clean markdown, text or JSON — including JavaScript-rendered pages and sites behind CAPTCHAs or anti-bot blocking that plain HTTP tools fail on. This plugin teaches the agent when and how to use the ScrapingBee CLI: scrape a single page or a CSV of URLs, crawl a whole site into files for a RAG index, search Google, Amazon, Walmart or YouTube and get structured JSON back, extract fields described in plain English, and schedule recurring checks — while keeping credit spend to the minimum that works. Requires a ScrapingBee account and API key.
defaultPrompt: Fetch this pricing page as markdown and save it to a file
Crawl this docs site and save every guide page for my RAG index
Get the current price and rating for this Amazon ASIN
I have a CSV of product URLs — refresh the price column in place
